metadata.title: You&Family — Time together isn't a luxury
metadata.description: We support families in Germany to go on holiday together — even when it feels out of reach.

hero.subline: We support families in Germany to go on holiday together — even when it feels out of reach. Apply and let's see how we can help.
hero.image_alt: A happy family on holiday — children and parents walking through a picturesque town

stats.label: Children in Germany live in poverty

funded_vacations.headline: Travel without worrying.
funded_vacations.text: We cover accommodation, travel, and activities — fully, with no hidden conditions.

personal_support.headline: Someone is always there for you.
personal_support.text: From the first enquiry to your return home, we accompany your family with advice, coordination, and an open ear.

lasting_network.headline: Connection that lasts beyond the holiday.
lasting_network.text: We connect you with other families and local resources — so the positive energy lasts.

mission.title: Time together isn't a luxury. It belongs to you.
mission.text: Every family deserves rest, connection, and memories — regardless of what's in your bank account. We believe shared experiences are the foundation of a strong family. That's why we make holidays possible, for everyone.
mission.image_alt: Family in nature with an artistic frame

stories.title: What other families say
stories.subline: Real stories from families like yours — what their week changed, and what they took home with them.

items.quote: We hadn't taken a holiday together in years. That week brought us back together as a family. The kids still talk about it today.
items.name: The Yilmaz family

items.quote: I never thought something like this was possible. The organisation was perfect, and we felt supported the entire time. A real gift.
items.name: The Meier family

items.quote: As a single mother, a holiday was just a dream. Now it has become reality. My daughter saw the sea for the first time.
items.name: Sara K.

contact_home.title: Write to us. We'll figure out together what's possible.
contact_home.text: Not sure if you qualify? Write to us anyway. No complicated paperwork, no interrogation. Just a short message — and we'll get back to you.

message.placeholder: What would you like to tell us?

form.success_text: Your message has reached us. We'll get back to you soon.

donate_page.title: You can be the reason a family goes on holiday.
donate_page.intro: You&Family was started by people who know from experience what time together means — mothers, fathers, families. We're still at the beginning, but we believe: with the right people beside us, we can make this real. If you want to be part of it — whether through a donation or your time — get in touch.
donate_page.image_alt: Family in nature with an artistic frame

donate.title: Donate
donate.text: Your financial support gives families a break they couldn't otherwise afford. Every contribution counts — large or small.

volunteer.title: Volunteer
volunteer.text: Want to contribute your time and energy? We're looking for people who want to pitch in — with organising, support, or communication.
